Governo.descrizione: Si è svolto, presso la Comunità di San Patrignano, l'Incontro internazionale di alto livello sulla prevenzione e il recupero dalle dipendenze, promosso da Italia e Francia, co-fondatori della Coalizione Europea contro le Droghe (ECAD). Questa mattina i lavori si sono aperti con l'intervento del Presidente Meloni. L'evento si è concluso con l'intervento del Sottosegretario Mantovano e l’adozione de

Si è svolta a Palazzo Chigi la riunione del Consiglio dei Ministri. Al termine il Ministro dell'Agricoltura, della Sovranità alimentare e delle Foreste, Francesco Lollobrigida, ed il Vice Ministro delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti, Edoardo Rixi, hanno illustrato in conferenza stampa i provvedimenti approvati.

Governo.titolo: Convocazione del Consiglio dei Ministri n. 194
Governo.descrizione: Il Consiglio dei ministri è convocato oggi, giovedì 22 ottobre 2026, alle ore 12:00 a Palazzo Chigi, per l’esame del seguente ordine del giorno: SCHEMA DI DECRETO-LEGGE: Disposizioni urgenti e misure di sostegno ai settori dell’autotrasporto, dell’agricoltura e della pesca (PRESIDENZA – INFRASTRUTTURE E TRASPORTI – AGRICOLTURA, SOVRANITÀ ALIMENTARE E FORESTE).

Governo.titolo: Concorso per 32 unità di personale non dirigenziale, a tempo pieno e indeterminato, di cui 2 unità da inquadrare nei ruoli della Pcm nella Categoria A F1, con profilo professionale di “specialista di segreterie direzionali” (codice 2AF1-PCM)
Governo.descrizione: Concorso pubblico, per titoli ed esami, per il reclutamento di n. 32 unità di personale non dirigenziale, a tempo pieno e indeterminato, di cui n. 2 da inquadrare nei ruoli della Presidenza del Consiglio dei ministri nella categoria A, posizione economica F1, con profilo professionale di “specialista di segreterie direzionali” (codice 2AF1-PCM). Graduatoria finale.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Deployment of NCTS Phase 6 – Next step in the modernization of customs and transit procedures
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The rollout of Phase 6 of the New Computerised Transit System (NCTS), now in use across the 27 EU Member States and the countries of the Common Transit Convention, marks a major step forward in the digital modernisation of customs and transit procedures across 41 participating countries.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New European Master’s in Translation (EMT) competence framework reflects how AI is changing translation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Discover the new European Master’s in Translation (EMT) competence framework, reflecting how AI and language technologies are reshaping the translation profession. It can help universities to prepare future translators to work critically, ethically and effectively in a changing industry.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Hydrogen Strategy – Commission launches consultation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has today launched a 4-week call for evidence and a 4-week targeted stakeholder consultation to gather input to help shape the forthcoming Hydrogen Strategy.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform with up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission launched the T-MED Investment Platform, to mobilise large-scale investment in renewable energy and clean technologies across the Mediterranean. The platform is a key component of the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean Tech Cooperation Initiative (T-MED)...

Commissione, notizie.titolo: CEF Energy 2026 call for PCI/PMI projects attracts strong interest with 67 applications requesting €2.88 billion
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has received 67 applications for cross-border energy infrastructure projects requesting €2.88 billion in EU co-funding under the Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) Energy programme.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ukraine Mine Action Conference 2026: clearing the way in partnership
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Ukraine Mine Action Conference (UMAC) is a key international initiative to advance humanitarian mine action in Ukraine, which is an essential part of Ukraine’s recovery, security and resilience.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New episode – DGT podcast: Languages and Technology
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Listen to episode 14 of the DGT podcast: Languages and Technology!

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Building bridges through science diplomacy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission, UNESCO and the Union for the Mediterranean set the stage for discussing science diplomacy at the SESAME synchrotron in Jordan.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: AI and skills in Europe – Closing the adoption gap
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In a recent brief, the Commission's Joint Research Centre notes that AI tools are now part of everyday work for around 30% of workers in the EU. Many jobs that could use AI do not do so, especially in smaller companies and among mid‑career staff.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Investing in skills for the competitiveness of small and medium companies
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: As Ireland leads the Presidency of the Council of the European Union, business leaders and policymakers met in Dublin to focus on a pressing question: how can Europe equip its small and medium-sized companies (SME) with the talent and skills they need to grow, innovate and compete?

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU announces an additional €22.5 million to reinforce humanitarian assistance in Yemen
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission is releasing €22.5 million in humanitarian aid to Yemen, in addition to the €87.5 million previously allocated for 2026, to address the consequences of the renewed conflict escalation and the critical needs of millions of people affected by the protracted crisis.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission opens investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct by Omya in the supply of calcium carbonates to the paper industry
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has opened a formal antitrust investigation to assess whether Omya has breached EU competition rules by requiring customers in the paper industry to purchase all or most of their calcium carbonates from Omya.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Enterprise Europe Network Annual Conference 2026: An Agile Network in a Changing World
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Enterprise Europe Network Annual Conference 2026 takes place 11-13 November at the Croke Park Conference Centre in Dublin, Ireland, with Network partners and stakeholders. Under the theme 'An Agile Network in a Changing World', 700 participants join onsite and online for 3 days of exchange.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Lahbib visits Ottawa for discussions on preparedness for health emergencies
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commissioner for Equality, Preparedness and Crisis Management, Hadja Lahbib will visit Ottawa to meet with Canadian authorities to discuss health emergencies preparedness and response. The trip includes a visit to an aircraft factory where a total of 24 firefighting aircraft are being produced.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Joint ministerial statement on the risk of famine in Sudan
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Sudan is experiencing an alarming deterioration in its food security. The risk of famine in the coming months, as warned by the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification, needs urgent action. There is no time to lose to save lives and prevent famine.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU civil protection mechanism turns 25
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Since its creation, it has been activated more than 900 times by 160 countries and 8 international organisations, coordinating assistance in response to wildfires, floods, earthquakes, health emergencies and other disasters across Europe and around the world.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and US Young Agricultural Leaders Set for a Week Exploring EU Farming in Policy and Practice
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Entering its second year, the EU-US Fellowship for Young Leaders in Agriculture continues to strengthen transatlantic collaboration. The programme deepens understanding of farmers’ challenges and promotes solutions to improve the long-term resilience and profitability of agriculture on both sides.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU plastic packaging waste hits 35.9 kg per capita
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Packaging waste per capita increased by 3.2 kg compared with 2023, and by 19.6 kg compared with 2014.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU detains a record 196 million counterfeit items worth € 6.3 billion in 2025
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The latest joint report published by the European Commission and the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) today reveals the highest number of counterfeit detentions ever recorded by EU enforcement authorities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The Commission welcomes the political agreement reached on the review of the Securitisation Framework
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Yesterday, the Commission welcomed the political agreement reached between the Parliament and the Council on the review of the EU Securitisation Framework. The agreed measures aim to support securitisation activity in the EU while safeguarding financial stability.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: IMCAP 2027: EU co-funding grants to bring the CAP closer to citizens
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The IMCAP 2027 call for proposals opens on 22 October 2026, offering 60% co-funding for projects that bring the CAP closer to citizens and strengthening trust in sustainable agriculture.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Beyond rent: the real cost of moving abroad for work
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Moving to another EU country for work? Don’t let the hidden costs catch you off guard. From utility deposits to your first pay cheque, here’s your essential guide to financial survival.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Oil Coordination Group discusses EU fuel market developments
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Experts from the European Commission, EU countries, the International Energy Agency (IEA) and the Energy Community met yesterday in the Oil Coordination Group to take stock of the recent developments in fuels markets.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ireland partners with the European Skills & VET Week
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In November, the Irish Presidency of the Council of the EU is joining the European Skills & VET Week to highlight how vocational education and training can respond to Europe’s rapidly changing skills needs. Read more about the Construction Sector Skills Forum and the 21st Cedefop Brussels Seminar.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Taking the European Network of Public Employment Services forward
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has confirmed the essential role of the European Network of Public Employment Services (PES Network) and proposes to extend its mandate beyond 2027.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Bio-based Europe Alliance launches to accelerate market uptake of sustainable bio-based solutions
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Alliance aims to provide clearer market signals, reduce investment uncertainty, and unlock the potential of Europe’s bioeconomy.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: One sea, shared security: EU and Libya take a first step together against CBRN threats
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From 11 to 15 October, Libyan first responders gathered in Tripoli for an EU-funded preparatory training followed by a field drill.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Western Balkan partners deepen research and innovation cooperation to support EU integration
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Research and innovation news alert: The European Union and the Western Balkan partners have endorsed a joint declaration to step up cooperation in research and innovation, reaffirming their shared commitment to the region’s path towards EU membership.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: European Capital of Innovation Awards (iCapital): 6 finalists cities announced
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 22 October 2027, the European Commission announced the finalists of the 2027 European Capital of Innovation Awards (iCapital), celebrating the European cities that are leading the way in urban innovation and shaping more sustainable, inclusive and resilient communities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €500,000 Slovenian State aid for agriculture, fishery and marine aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved a €500,0000 Slovenian State aid scheme for agriculture, fishery and marine aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices due to the Middle East crisis.
